key_points: Small share buybacks (~$156M total) signal capital return but are modest for HSBC's scale
Routine SEC filings (6-K, 25-NSE) and NYSE note removal are administrative noise
Shore Capital maintains 'hold' rating (1,380p target) citing valuation caution despite UK growth opportunities
HSBC's equity strategy upgrade of India/downgrade of China reflects research views, not direct bank fundamentals
Mixed short-term price commentary (3% daily gain vs bearish 1,120p forecast) indicates no clear catalyst
